topic: Hand off a real task: let Claude Cowork tidy your messy Downloads folder
post:
How many files are in your Downloads folder right now? 😅
Here's a 5-minute Claude Cowork handoff that cleans it up.

Organizing a messy Downloads folder by type and date is one of the example tasks in Claude's own Cowork guide.

Step by step 👇

1️⃣ Open the Claude desktop app and select "Cowork" in the message box
2️⃣ Share ONLY your Downloads folder (not your whole drive)
3️⃣ Describe the result you want
4️⃣ Review Claude's plan, then let it run

Copy this prompt:
"Organize my Downloads folder. Create folders by type (Documents, Images, Spreadsheets, Installers, Other) and sort files into them by year. Don't delete anything. Show me your plan first, and list any files you're unsure about."

The two safety lines that matter 🔐
✅ "Don't delete anything"
✅ "Show me your plan first"

Good to know: Cowork is on paid plans (Pro, Max, Team, Enterprise), and working with files on your computer needs the Claude desktop app.

Why it matters:
An AI that can take actions is most useful on boring, repeatable chores. Start small, keep the rules clear, and you stay in control. ✨

What's the messiest folder on your computer? 👇
